name: Tvg_Blend_Method
brief: Enumeration indicates the method used for blending paint. Please refer to the respective formulas for each method.

members.name: TVG_BLEND_METHOD_NORMAL
members.brief: Perform the alpha blending(default). S if (Sa == 255), otherwise (Sa * S) + (255 - Sa) * D

members.name: TVG_BLEND_METHOD_MULTIPLY
members.brief: Takes the RGB channel values from 0 to 255 of each pixel in the top layer and multiples them with the values for the corresponding pixel from the bottom layer. (S * D)

members.name: TVG_BLEND_METHOD_SCREEN
members.brief: The values of the pixels in the two layers are inverted, multiplied, and then inverted again. (S + D) - (S * D)

members.name: TVG_BLEND_METHOD_OVERLAY
members.brief: Combines Multiply and Screen blend modes. (2 * S * D) if (2 * D < Da), otherwise (Sa * Da) - 2 * (Da - S) * (Sa - D)

members.name: TVG_BLEND_METHOD_DARKEN
members.brief: Creates a pixel that retains the smallest components of the top and bottom layer pixels. min(S, D)

members.name: TVG_BLEND_METHOD_LIGHTEN
members.brief: Only has the opposite action of Darken Only. max(S, D)

members.name: TVG_BLEND_METHOD_COLORDODGE
members.brief: Divides the bottom layer by the inverted top layer. D / (255 - S)

members.name: TVG_BLEND_METHOD_COLORBURN
members.brief: Divides the inverted bottom layer by the top layer, and then inverts the result. 255 - (255 - D) / S

members.name: TVG_BLEND_METHOD_HARDLIGHT
members.brief: The same as Overlay but with the color roles reversed. (2 * S * D) if (S < Sa), otherwise (Sa * Da) - 2 * (Da - S) * (Sa - D)

members.name: TVG_BLEND_METHOD_SOFTLIGHT
members.brief: Darkens or lightens the colors, depending on the source color value. If S <= 0.5: D - (1 - 2 * S) * D * (1 - D), otherwise: D + (2 * S - 1) * (G(D) - D), where G(D) = ((16 * D - 12) * D + 4) * D if D <= 0.25, otherwise sqrt(D).

members.name: TVG_BLEND_METHOD_DIFFERENCE
members.brief: Subtracts the bottom layer from the top layer or the other way around, to always get a non-negative value. (S - D) if (S > D), otherwise (D - S)

members.name: TVG_BLEND_METHOD_EXCLUSION
members.brief: The result is twice the product of the top and bottom layers, subtracted from their sum. s + d - (2 * s * d)

members.name: TVG_BLEND_METHOD_HUE
members.brief: Uses the hue of the source and the saturation and luminosity of the destination.

members.name: TVG_BLEND_METHOD_SATURATION
members.brief: Uses the saturation of the source and the hue and luminosity of the destination.

members.name: TVG_BLEND_METHOD_COLOR
members.brief: Uses the hue and saturation of the source and the luminosity of the destination.

members.name: TVG_BLEND_METHOD_LUMINOSITY
members.brief: Uses the luminosity of the source and the hue and saturation of the destination.

members.name: TVG_BLEND_METHOD_ADD
members.brief: Simply adds pixel values of one layer with the other. (S + D)
